shared_elements: upright freestanding stone monument carved in low relief
vertical orientation with decoration concentrated on the front face
incised curvilinear detail within enclosed shapes
justification: Both are tall, weathered relief-carved stone uprights whose surfaces are covered with rounded, cartouche-like enclosed motifs containing curvilinear interior detail, and both show discrete circular elements. But A is a single large sculptural composition — a massive body-like mass with a head, headdress and a chest disc, carved in bold, sparse, high-relief volumes — whereas B is a flat slab covered by a strict grid of many small, uniformly sized square blocks in rows and columns, giving an entirely different overall organisation and density.
